2. The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Lohardaga (Mahila) P.S. Case No. 41 of 2022(Special POCSO Case No.38 of 2023) registered under sections 323, 341, 376, 313, 504, 506,

entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. As per FIR, allegation is that the brother of the petitioner namely Sumit Saw used to take tuition of the victim girl studying in class-X.
The brother of the petitioner molested the victim girl and took several obscene videos and photographs of her and threated her to make the same viral on social media.
It is further alleged that petitioner along with others spanked and battered the victim girl and administered some medicine to her to terminate her abortion.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the petitioner is innocent and has committed no offence at all rather he has been falsely implicated in this case only because he is brother of the main accused-Sumit Saw.
There is general and omnibus allegation against the petitioner about indulging in assaulting the victim and administrating some medicine to her.
It is further submitted that the victim has been examined in this case but she has attributed no overt act against the petitioner.
The main accused-Sumit Saw is still under custody.

Petitioner undertakes to co-operate with the trial of the case and remain physically present on each and every date till the conclusion of the trial and shall not indulge in tampering with the prosecution evidence or influence the witnesses or gain over them.
It is next submitted that the petitioner has no criminal antecedent.
The petitioner is languishing in judicial custody since 09.06.2023 without any rhymes and reasons.

Hence the petitioner may be enlarged on bail.
5.
Learned Addl. P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner.
Hence, the petitioner may not be enlarged on bail.
